description: Before order_vps: the per-order maximum (`max_quantity` = 50, a typo guard; `limit_reason` max_per_order) and which add-ons a plan has with their monthly price (`addons.backups`, `addons.extra_ipv4`). Orders are never refused for capacity — servers without free room are queued for creation (usually within 24 hours, see `queue_note`). Pass the same `product` and `months` (or `period`/`plan_id`) you will order; the response carries `months`, `term_price` (plan price for the term, one server, before add-ons and an automatic offer) and `terms` (1–36 months, quick picks 1/3/6/12). Works without a token. Requires: nothing (with a token the limit is for your account; without one — as for a new account).

addons.description: Optional. Add-ons to price: array of "backups" and/or "extra_ipv4", e.g. ["backups"]. Default: none.

location.description: Optional. Server country to check: "de" (Germany) or "fi" (Finland). Default: automatic placement.

months.description: Optional. Billing term in months, integer 1–36 (default 1); 12 = the annual plan. Takes precedence over period/plan_id.

period.description: Optional. Billing period to price: "month" (default) or "year". Ignored when `months` or `plan_id` is given.

plan_id.description: Optional. Billing plan id from list_plans `plans[].plan_id`, integer, e.g. 24. Ignored when `months` is given.

product.description: Required. Plan slug from list_plans, e.g. "nano-ip".

name: get_order_limits
title: Order limits & add-ons
